Post-stratiﬁcation was performed on age, gender, race/ethnicity, region, party registration, and 2024 presidential vote. You can see a full methodology statement here, which complies with the requirements of AAPOR's Transparency Initiative. Members of the Transparency Initiative disclose all relevant details about our research, with the principle that the public should be able to evaluate and understand research-based ﬁndings, in order to instill and restore public conﬁdence in survey results.

[IF ID-01] Russ Fulcher is a fourth-generation Idahoan and former state senator who has represented Idaho’s First District in Congress since 2019, winning four terms. A member of the House Freedom Caucus, he has backed President Trump’s agenda and authored the federal No Tax on Overtime Pay provision. Sarah Zabel is a retired Air Force major general who served 31 years in communications and cybersecurity. A registered Republican for three decades, she left the party and is running as an Independent, focused on the national debt, Social Security, and protecting public lands. Jim Risch has represented Idaho in the U.S. Senate since 2009 and is running for a fourth term. He previously served as Governor and Lieutenant Governor, and ﬁrst won oﬃce in 1970. He chairs the Senate Foreign Relations Committee and has been endorsed by President Trump. Todd Achilles is an Army veteran and former technology executive at T-Mobile and Hewlett-Packard. He served in the Idaho House as a Democrat before leaving the party in 2025 to run as an Independent, campaigning on term limits, a congressional stock trading ban, and public lands.
